svg.text: Internal API on App Service · reference implementation
internal-api v1.0 · Pilot light · eastus primary, westus IaC only · numbered request path, lettered replication, T telemetry

g.text: Hub VNet · hub-vnet-eastus 10.0.0.0/21 · platform owned · inherited
Spoke VNet · /22 from IPAM · workload owned
pe-subnet · private endpoints only · no public access
Observability · platform owned path · required log fields: app_id, env, tier, correlation_id
Inherited from the hub, not built by the workload
APIM policies: JWT validation, rate limit, correlation header
Firewall egress rules requested through a change request
Private DNS zones linked at spoke creation by the developer portal
PE · Entra auth only · geo-backup to westus
PE · access policy model · purge protection
PE · GRS · CMK from Key Vault · no public
Why access policy, not RBAC · ADR-internal-api-003
Platform automation hit RBAC propagation delay on first deploy
Emit common-schema JSON with app_id, env, tier, correlation_id. Diagnostic settings are applied by DINE, not by the module.
Alerts: SRE alert collection for App Service and SQL is attached at intake. Custom alerts stay in the workload Log Analytics workspace.
Evidence: Sentinel workspace name and workbook link recorded in the conformance test output.
1 user signs in with Entra · 2 request to the internal APIM name steered by Traffic Manager · 3 APIM to App Service over private endpoint · 4 SQL over PE with managed identity
5 secrets and certs from Key Vault · 6 blobs to Storage over PE · A geo-backup to westus, restore on declared DR · T diagnostics to Log Analytics, Event Hubs, Sentinel
Not drawn on purpose: workload-owned APIM, firewall or DNS zone; public IPs on PaaS; secrets in code. DR strategy, RTO and RPO come from the resilience standard and CMDB.
